description_en: Located in the eastern part of Cyāsal and on the southern part of the road to Bālkumarī, Aśoka Stūpa Phalcā stands in the north-western corner of Cilācaitya. It is built on a very steep mound in such a way that there is a shop below it. An icon of Nāmasaṃgiti has been fixed on the northern wall. According to the inscription, the Cilãcaitya in front of thePhalcā is believed to be one of the fourcaityasconstructed during the reign of the Great King Aśoka of Magadha (India) about 2250 years ago.The three bay, free-standing Phalcā was dismantled and rebuilt in 2014 without the incorporation of any of the original elements. A marble inscription can be found on the outer southern wall of the Phalcā. Its bays have been closed off with latticework and a wooden door.
description_ne: यो फल्चा च्यासल टोलको पूर्वी भागमा,  चिलँ चैत्यभन्दा उत्तरपश्चिमपट्टि बालकुमारी जाने बाटापट्टि रहेको छ । चिलँ चैत्य मगधका राजा अशोकको पालामा लगभग २२५० वर्ष पहिला बनेको मानिन्छ । तीनवटा कवल भएको यो फल्चा अरू घरसँग जोडिएको छैन । फल्चाको तल्लो तहमा पसल राखिएको छ । यस फल्चाको उत्तरी भित्तामा नामसङ्गीतिको मूर्ति टाँसिएको छ भने दक्षिणी बाहिरी भित्तामा एउटा मार्बलको शिलालेख टाँसिएको छ । यो फल्चा सन् २०१४ मा भत्काएर पुराना सामानहरूको प्रयोग नगरी पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो ।

historical_events.event_description: According to an inscription, thestūpabelongs to one of the fourstūpasallegedly established by Aśoka (the Tiwari report carries a photograph of a part of thecapāḥand Phalcā on pp. 19 and 34).

Aśoka Stūpa Phalcā was dismantled and rebuilt without the incorporation of any of the original materials. The construction was funded by Lalitpur Metropolitan city (7,370,749 NRS) and undertaken by people from Kvaylāchi Cyāsal Tole. The marble inscription has been incorporated into the western side of the front façade (S).
